violations.text: The door to the outside, located in the back, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Raw food was being prepped in the close proximity of clean dishes/ utensils and food. Discussed prep procedures with PIC to prevent potential contamination of raw food with RTE/clean equipment. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine have an accumulation of bio-film. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 08/17/2026

Raw animal foods were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods in the outside walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Guidance document provided. PIC relocated food at time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, knives) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Both pieces of equipment were taken to dish machine to be cleaned. Can opener shall be fully washed rinsed and sanitized after use. Dirty knives shall not be placed on clean knife rack. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

Cooked Pork, which was prepared in advance (yesterday), was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Pork was observed at 46 degrees. Pork was disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

ROP imitation crab was observed thawing with package in tact. Guidance document provided. ROP crab was 35 degrees and removed from the package. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026

The door to the outside, located in the back, is not tight-fitting. Screen is falling off and bottom of door is not tight fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/10/2026

Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Discussed proper storage of utensils with PIC. PIC stated hot holding will be used. Utensils placed in dish machine. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026
The bar cooler was observed with a large accumulation of stagnant water. Cooler to be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice machine, portable fans, and shelving of lowboy units have an accumulation of debris. Both units to be cleaned/sanitized. New Violation. Correct By: 07/27/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the shelving in the basement have an accumulation of old rodent droppings. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/17/2024

The door to the outside, located in the kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. PIC stated door sweep will be added. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2024

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by new droppings. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the shelving in the kitchen have an accumulation of droppings. All items must be removed from shelf and shelf must be washed, rinsed, and sanitized. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2024
The floors in the basement area has an accumulation of rodent droppings. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/03/2024
The Person in charge did not assure compliance with critical code requirements. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024
The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety with RIDOH. Application printed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024
Beans and ginger slice were observed in direct contact with rodent droppings/ gnawed product. Both foods were disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024

Raw animal foods were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Food storage poster provided. PIC relocated foods. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024

Food contact surfaces of the ice machine were observed with an accumulation of debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC disposed of ice and started to clean and sanitize ice machine. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024

Soup was observed held at 79 degrees Fahrenheit. Soup was at room temperature over night. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food to no longer be stored at room temperature over night. Soup was disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024

Various foods were observed held above 41 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. 1. The walk-in inside the kitchen foods were being held at 43 degrees. Establishment to only store non TCS foods in walk-in until serviced/repaired. 2. Various foods were observed held out of temperature. Establishment to work in half portions. Food was moved to prep units/walk-ins to rapidly cool. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024

Multiple foods were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024

The door to the outside, located in the kitchen, is not tight-fitting. Screen door was observed with a hole in the screen. Screen must be repaired or replaced. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024

The presence of rodents is not controlled as evidenced by droppings throughout the facility and adulterated product. The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024
2 dead rodents were observed in the basement at the time of inspection. Dead rodents must be removed from the premises. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024
An open container of shelf stable sauce was observed stored on the floor in the kitchen. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024
Utensils were observed stored in stagnant water between uses. Utensils were moved to water being hot held. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024

The inside walk-in was observed maintaining an ambient temperature of 44-45 degrees. All food inside of unit was 43 degrees. Unit must be used for non TCS foods until repaired. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024

The non-food contact surfaces of the following had an accumulation of debris: -The sheet pan holding the rack for the cutting boards had an accumulation of rodent droppings. -The shelving in the basement had an accumulation of rodent droppings. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the basement area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024

The floors throughout the facility area has an accumulation of rodent droppings. The floor underneath the cook line has an accumulation of grease and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2024
